routes.name: Two Years Residence Permit (Business people permit)

note: Lesotho, read on 2026-10-30 on the Ministry of Home Affairs' Immigration page (homeaffairs.gov.ls) and its residence permit portal (homeaffairslesotho.com, run for it by VFS Global). The Department of Immigration Services issues residence permits of four types (a temporary permit for 90 days, a two years residence permit for 2 years, a study permit for 4 years and an indefinite permit) in categories that include missionaries, business people, joining relatives, spouses, doctors and nurses and teachers; no category is named for performers or for employees in general. The Business People Permit 'is issued to an applicant that currently has a business in The Kingdom of Lesotho or for applicant that wish to open a business' (for self-employment, the nearest of the form's purposes; its documents also list a work permit certified by the Department of Labour and Employment, a letter from the employer and an employment contract, so it serves those working in a business too). The two years' permit lasts 2 years (term) and is renewed with a copy of the previous permit (renewable). Applications are accepted at the Residence Permit Facilitation Centre in Maseru, with a medical certificate from a government practitioner within Lesotho and a police clearance from Lesotho (in country). The same category is given as an Indefinite Permit (permanent), asked the same way; the pages don't say after how many years. Neither page says what work the residence permit itself allows (the work permit is the Labour Department's), so work is left out. Fees are set by the Aliens Control (Amendment of Schedule) Regulations, 2018, which weren't found online, so no fee is kept; processing time is 'managed by the Ministry', none published. Naturalisation: those lawfully resident 5 or more years may apply for citizenship (the Immigration page), which the form here doesn't hold.

sources.said: Types of Residence Permits: ... Two years residence permit for 2 years ... Indefinite Permit. ... Categories of Residence Permits: ... Business permit ... Non-Basotho citizens who have been residing lawfully in Lesotho for 5 or more years are legible to apply for Lesotho citizenship.
